segments.k0: This is DiaBite. You type a meal the way you would say it.
segments.k1: The engine finds each food and does the arithmetic. It fits, and the receipt shows every number.
segments.k2: An evening meal that does not fit does not just get a no. It names a swap, and the engine counts it. Now it fits.
segments.k3: A meal can also be planned for another day. A plan counts nowhere until it is eaten.
segments.k4: And a dose question is refused at once, before any model sees it.
